# TCV Bazaar

> TCV Bazaar is Gwalior's premium Diwali exhibition and marketplace by The City Vibes Marketing. Exhibitors book stalls online; visitors get three nights of festive shopping, food and music at Keshar Towers, Gwalior (23–25 October 2026).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of TCV Bazaar 2026 Diwali Edition and how to book.
- [About](/about): Story, values and team behind TCV Bazaar.
- [Why Exhibit](/why-exhibit): Footfall, audience and business outcomes for brands.
- [Packages](/packages): Premium, Standard, Sharing, Tabler and Branding Spot pricing.
- [Stall Layout](/stall-layout): Interactive floor plan with live stall availability.
- [Book](/book): Package selection, stall reservation and online payment.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from past editions of TCV Bazaar.
- [Videos](/videos): Aftermovies and highlight reels.
- [Testimonials](/testimonials): Exhibitor experiences.
- [FAQ](/faq): Booking, payment, package and layout questions.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, WhatsApp and email for the TCV Bazaar team.
